findings.evidence: The locator attributes finite propagating-mode count to “the stated waveguide class,” but [Beisert, §13.4–13.5, PDF pp. 156–157](https://people.phys.ethz.ch/~nbeisert/lectures/ED-24FS-Skript.pdf#page=157) treats a conducting-wall guide eigenproblem with vacuum Maxwell fields. The definition allows a broader uniform lossless guide with unspecified transverse coefficients and wall conditions. Because the finite channel list is explicitly assumed, the definition remains conditional; qualify the locator to the source’s guide setting or cite a source covering the broader class.
